modes.placeholder_behavior: PlaceholderMode (src/modes/PlaceholderMode.ts): run continues, events counted as skipped, no gameplay
modes.note: PATTERN_FUNCTIONS includes 'TRANSITION' but that is a pattern metadata label (RP10, RP22), unconsumed at runtime

lead_in_beats.pattern_section: min(max library telegraphBeats over the section's mechanics, beatsPerBar)

compile.breather_from_beat: (startBar-1+lengthBars)*beatsPerBar - max(6, round(3*bpm/60)) when mode changes, else null (LevelLoader.ts:375-378)

scheduling.switch_beat: incomingSection.startBeat - incomingSection.leadInBeats (may be negative; fires during count-in)
scheduling.fixed_order: scheduleSections before scheduleLevel before scheduleCourses (BeatBoundGame.ts:189-191); the mode switch fires before same-beat pattern/course spawns (BeatClock FIFO within a beat)
scheduling.spawn_suppression: PatternScheduler.ts:89 skips events whose activationBeat >= section.breatherFromBeat
scheduling.course_spawn: scheduleCourse: spawnBeat = course.startBeat - course.leadInBeats, synthetic 'R-COURSE' mechanic through the same sink (src/mechanics/runner/courseSchedule.ts:46-76)

cross_mode_order: previous.deactivate(atBeat)  -- clears all mechanics of the outgoing mode
flushPending(mode)  -- hands over early-spawned mechanics (MAX_PENDING=64, FIFO overflow drop)
transition = { id, from, to, startBeat, lengthBeats: sceneBeats=2 }
set_mode.routing: ModeManager.route routes purely on mechanic definition.mode; pending queue holds spawns for modes not yet live (ModeManager.ts:117-137)

per_cross_cell.spawn_suppression: >= max(6, round(bpm/20)) beats before section end
per_cross_cell.minimum_quiet_time: 6 beats floor (~3s nominal, 2.81s worst case at 128 BPM)

cell_differences: -> pattern-based RUNNER: first obstacle spawned 4 beats early goes through the pending queue and appears on screen already ~3/4 scrolled in (compressed warning, still beat-accurate)
-> VERTICAL/RADIAL: first note approach (2 beats x tier telegraphScale) fully visible from the switch beat (leadIn matched to telegraph)

breather.trigger: adjacent sections with different modes only (LevelLoader.ts:332-334)

behavior.warnings_of_suppressed_events: never created (the mechanic object is never built)
behavior.notes_holds_crossing: holds spawned before the breather may extend past the section end; cut without penalty at the switch beat

hud_overlay.shows: NEXT: <mode>, incoming mode key hints (MODE_CONTROLS), 3-2-1 countdown mapped to countdownSeconds

breather.guarantee: >= 6 beats; ~3s nominal but Math.round can undershoot to ~2.81s (128 BPM region)

state_handoff.health: preserved (single HealthManager for the whole run, shared by all modes; reset only at run start) - src/core/RunStatus.ts, src/core/HealthManager.ts
state_handoff.score_hits_notes: preserved (RunStatus.hits / notesHit / notesMissed accumulate across modes)
state_handoff.combo: reset on incoming mode activate (NoteMode.activate, src/modes/rhythm/NoteMode.ts:82-87); preserved across same-mode boundaries; ARENA/RUNNER have no combo
state_handoff.invulnerability: preserved (invulnerableUntil in song seconds, 0.8s window, TUNING.health.invulnerableSeconds; can span the switch)
state_handoff.position: reset (new mode initializes: ArenaPlayer -> (0.5,0.5), RunnerPlayer -> GROUND_Y, NoteMode has no player)
state_handoff.held_keys: preserved (global Input.down set is never cleared on mode change; window blur clears)
state_handoff.active_hold_notes: dropped at deactivate without penalty (no MISS, no damage)
state_handoff.difficulty: section-local, applied per spawn (PatternScheduler.ts:111 -> MechanicRegistry tier)

input_handoff.model: single global Input (src/core/Input.ts); modes read shared binding tables (src/core/controls.ts); no per-mode input map
input_handoff.held_keys_across_switch: preserved and immediately re-interpreted by the incoming mode
input_handoff.cleared_only_on: window blur (Input.ts:24); pressedThisFrame cleared by endFrame each frame
input_handoff.stuck_key_risk: keyup handled globally; OS-level lost keyup: NEEDS RUNTIME VERIFICATION
input_handoff.explanation: the switch fires inside clock.update() before modes.update(); only the current mode updates each frame (ModeManager.ts:155)

conflicts: holding s/arrowdown entering RUNNER -> immediate slide
holding a/s/d/arrows entering ARENA -> immediate movement (axis is isDown-based)
held keys do not auto-trigger note judgement (wasPressed needs a fresh keydown edge)

camera_handoff.model: single shared CameraFX (zoom pulse + shake/kick) applied every frame via GameFeel.applyCamera (src/feel/GameFeel.ts:182-185)
camera_handoff.residual_transform: none (Renderer.resetCamera at frame start; all modes draw in the same normalized 0..1 field space)
camera_handoff.scroll_offset: RUNNER track position is a pure function of absolute beat (trackX, src/mechanics/runner/runnerGeometry.ts:30-32); no camera offset state
camera_handoff.transition_visual: ModeManager.renderTransition (ModeManager.ts:172-191): 2-beat overlay wipe in the incoming mode colour + mode name + transitionOut label; purely decorative

cleanup.ARENA: deactivate: mechanics=[] -- bullets, chains, lasers, floor warnings, sweeps, fans all removed instantly
cleanup.RUNNER: deactivate: mechanics=[] -- half-scrolled obstacles and the whole course (R-COURSE) removed instantly
cleanup.VERTICAL: deactivate: mechanics=[] (NoteMode.ts:89-91) -- all notes incl. HOLDING removed; hold cut without penalty
cleanup.pending_queues: kept for modes not yet live; flushed only when that mode activates; cleared by clearHazards()
cleanup.cross_mode_damage_window: old-mode hazards remain lethal from breather start until the switch beat (breather does NOT end active hazards); impossible after the switch beat
cleanup.death_path: onDeath -> clock.clearSchedule() (cancels future mode switches too) + modes.clearHazards() (all instantiated modes + pending) (src/game/BeatBoundGame.ts:435-441)

beat_clock.music_continuity: uninterrupted; mode switch never touches the SongPlayer (AudioContext-clock anchored, src/core/AudioEngine.ts)
beat_clock.section_alignment: switch at (startBar-1)*beatsPerBar - leadInBeats, scheduled in musical time; negative switch beats legal (bar 1 is live during count-in)
beat_clock.latency: single global anchor (startCtxTime); per-callback latency stats only; no per-mode differences
beat_clock.next_mode_first_event_alignment: exact to the pattern's absolute beat; telegraph/approach visible from the switch beat
beat_clock.visual_freeze: hit-stop freezes visualBeat only, never the schedule or audio

transitionOut.runtime_effect: display-only: becomes the transition overlay label id (BeatBoundGame.ts:217-218 -> ModeManager.ts:188)

scene_effects.parser: tolerated (loader ignores unknown fields); NOT in SectionDefinition; violates level.schema.json additionalProperties:false

course.runtime_effect: full (planned at load, spawned 1 bar early)

course_generate.runtime_effect: full (expanded at load via composeCourse, LevelLoader.ts:402-413)

course_seed.runtime_effect: none (composeCourse consumes generate.seed; compiled course.seed never read)

event_role.runtime_effect: carried but never branched on (all roles spawn identically)

transition_timing.first_incoming_lethal_event: at its pattern activation beat (usually the section's first beat)

same_mode_boundary.evidence: ModeManager.ts:96 early return; real consumer: src/lab/labs.ts sequence() (99-135)
same_mode_boundary.note: behaviour derived from code and exercised by labs; no shipped level uses adjacent same-mode sections

difficulty_continuity.all_modes_effect: library telegraph > 0 is multiplied by tier.telegraphScale at spawn (MechanicRegistry.ts:144-150); intensity only shortens, floored at 0.6 beats / constraints.minReactionBeats (src/core/Intensity.ts:17-27)
difficulty_continuity.arena_only_effect: travelScale/gapScale on projectiles/rings/spirals/sweeps; slowed() stretches duration by the same factor
difficulty_continuity.immediate: yes - the change applies from the first spawn of the incoming section, no smoothing
difficulty_continuity.example: difficulty 4 ARENA -> difficulty 1 RUNNER: RUNNER/next spawns immediately use EASY telegraph budget

known_risks.scenario: long-duration ARENA mechanic (A07/A08/A11, slowed() variants) active across the breather
known_risks.detail: breather suppresses new spawns only; an already-active hazard stays lethal until the switch beat. runtime offers no early end
known_risks.mitigation: compiler keeps last outgoing activation well before breatherFromBeat

known_risks.detail: first obstacle spawned 4 beats early waits in pending; visible only from the switch beat, already ~3/4 scrolled (compressed warning, beat-accurate)
known_risks.mitigation: use course-based RUNNER sections after a mode change, or keep the first RUNNER activation >= 4 beats into the section

known_risks.detail: a/s/d/arrows held into ARENA cause immediate drift; s/arrowdown held into RUNNER causes immediate slide
known_risks.mitigation: compiler cannot control the player; telegraphs and breather reduce surprise

known_risks.scenario: damage invulnerability active at the switch
known_risks.detail: 0.8s window persists in song time; the incoming mode's first hit may be silently absorbed

known_risks.scenario: pending queue overflow for one mode (>64)
known_risks.detail: oldest spawn silently dropped, droppedSpawns counter incremented (HUD-visible), no warning
clock.clearSchedule() also cancels the scheduled mode switch; world frozen in the outgoing mode

known_risks.scenario: section into DUO (or any unregistered mode)
known_risks.detail: PlaceholderMode: no hazards, events counted as skipped, run continues
tier telegraphScale/travelScale change immediately for the next spawn; e.g. INTENSE -> EASY lengthens warnings by 67%

transition_safety.breather_formula: max(6, round(bpm/20)) beats, measured back from the outgoing section's end beat
transition_safety.clear_previous_hazards_at: mode switch beat (outgoing sectionEndBeat - incoming leadInBeats), NOT at breather start
transition_safety.hold_cut_penalty: none (no MISS, no damage; combo reset by incoming activate)
transition_safety.section_boundary_definition: bar line (incoming section startBar) minus leadInBeats (<= 1 bar; max(4, beatsPerBar) for courses)

compiler_required: last outgoing event activation strictly < breatherFromBeat (>= is suppressed); keep the active-window tail clear of the switch beat
avoid long-duration mechanics (A07/A08/A11, slowed() variants) in the final bars before a mode change
same-mode section boundaries get NO runtime breather - manage density manually
incoming first event should activate at or after its startBar (earlier is possible via pending but visually compressed)
single-mode buffered spawns <= 64 (MAX_PENDING) to avoid silent drops
expect held-key carryover across the switch (input is global state)
fill section gaps explicitly (empty bars keep the outgoing mode running with a load warning)

unreachable_or_dead_detail: DUO runtime path (PlaceholderMode) - implemented fallback, unreachable from shipped content
ModeManager.pending long-term buffering for a never-activating mode - reachable only in pathological levels (overflow silently drops at 64)
